description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /ReportingWebService/ReportingWebService.asmx.
affected_versions: Microsoft Windows Server 2012: 6.2.9200.0 to <6.2.9200.25728; Microsoft Windows Server 2012 (Server Core installation): 6.2.9200.0 to <6.2.9200.25728; Microsoft Windows Server 2012 R2: 6.3.9600.0 to <6.3.9600.22826; Microsoft Windows Server 2012 R2 (Server Core installation): 6.3.9600.0 to <6.3.9600.22826; Microsoft Windows Server 2016: 10.0.14393.0 to <10.0.14393.8524; Microsoft Windows Server 2016 (Server Core installation): 10.0.14393.0 to <10.0.14393.8524; Microsoft Windows Server 2019: 10.0.17763.0 to <10.0.17763.7922; Microsoft Windows Server 2019 (Server Core installation): 10.0.17763.0 to <10.0.17763.7922; Microsoft Windows Server 2022: 10.0.20348.0 to <10.0.20348.4297; Microsoft Windows Server 2022, 23H2 Edition (Server Core installation): 10.0.25398.0 to <10.0.25398.1916; Microsoft Windows Server 2025: 10.0.26100.0 to <10.0.26100.6905; Microsoft Windows Server 2025 (Server Core installation): 10.0.26100.0 to <10.0.26100.6905; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /ReportingWebService/ReportingWebService.asmx.
limitations: The body or authentication mechanism is not inspected; disabling this delivery endpoint is not exploit detection. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate uses of this operation too. This is a temporary containment option for policies that can disable the operation; review application compatibility before enabling.
